breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly perpetuates the error by replacing the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load and calling it 'exact,' computing δ = 11.39 mm. It even acknowledges the correct integration result (5.696 mm) but dismisses it, stating the concentrated-load method is 'the method of record.' The ground truth removes this incorrect instruction entirely and relies solely on the integration approach, yielding δ ≈ 5.696 mm. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
